name: Seewald (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically black and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Seewald (a black capercaillie on white).
history: Municipal flag of Seewald; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Seewald arms — black capercaillie on white
